name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success | Onboarding, Technical Troubleshooting, HubSpot Workflows & CRM Data
summary: Customer success and operations specialist who handles onboarding, troubleshooting, and the CRM behind it. I build and maintain HubSpot and GoHighLevel workflows, keep CRM data clean, and debug technical issues myself, down to the webhook or integration error. At Birdeye I onboarded and supported 15-20 partners and kept all but one by watching account health and escalating early. I write plain-language documentation that customers and teams can use on their own.

experience.title: Client Success & CRM Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Onboard clients to new systems and serve as their day-to-day contact for how-to questions and issues, training owners and staff before go-live.
Build and optimize workflows and automations in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, and keep CRM data clean with validated imports and data-hygiene standards.
Troubleshoot technical issues directly, tracing integration and messaging failures through webhooks, APIs, and JSON payloads.
Document systems and fixes so teams can run them on their own, and wrote 18 plain-language articles explaining technical topics.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, including agencies focused on healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94%).
Analyzed partner utilization to spot at-risk accounts early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, and fed structured feedback to Product and Engineering.
